answer: Agents managing a reef, irrigating a terrace, or monitoring a lagoon can settle disputes through stake-weighted voting: each vote carries weight proportional to tokens locked for 30 days. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand fake identities still yields only 100 tokens of influence. To gain more power, an attacker must acquire and lock more tokens, tying up capital and forgoing other uses; creating identities alone buys no extra votes.
